name: JLCPCB Standard Mouse-Bites Panelization
fallback_condition: Use when V-cuts unavailable due to board size constraints

text.comment: DO NOT POPULATE area between mouse-bites

notes: Mouse-bites (0.6mm drilled holes) connect boards; user snaps apart post-soldering. Suitable for compact/prototype boards. Requires manual breakout after fab (dremel/side-cutters).

panel_sizes.1x1: Original board size + 5mm frame + drilled perimeter

dfm_checklist: Minimum board dimension >= 20×20mm (JLCPCB requirement for mouse-bites)
No components within 3mm of mouse-bite holes
Mouse-bites must NOT intersect with vias or traces
Solder mask clearance around mouse-bite holes >= 0.1mm
jlcpcb_advantages: Allows panelization of small boards (20×20mm minimum)
Lower cost than V-cuts (no special equipment needed)
jlcpcb_disadvantages: Not suitable for high-mix assembly (slow manual breakout)
Risk of PCB damage during breakout if not careful

post_fab_assembly.step_1: Receive panelized PCBs with mouse-bites intact
post_fab_assembly.step_2: Optionally pre-reflow solder (if no components in breakout area)
post_fab_assembly.step_3: Manually snap off at mouse-bite holes using pliers or dremel
post_fab_assembly.step_4: Sand/file edges to remove burrs (optional but recommended)

cost_estimate_usd.notes: Lower cost than V-cuts; actual price depends on panel area, layer count, finish. Breakout labor not included.

k1_lightwave_recommendation.reason: Board is large enough for V-cut panelization; cleaner separation.
k1_lightwave_recommendation.fallback: Switch to mouse-bites if prototype requires smaller form factor
